import pandas as pd

# File paths for source CSVs
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_74/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_74/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_74/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_74/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_74/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_74/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_74/training_6.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_74/training_7.csv",
]

# Read all source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Union all source tables (concatenate)
df_union = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# According to intermediate_step1.csv, some NaNs in numeric columns should be replaced with 0.0
# Fill NaNs in numeric columns with 0.0 to match intermediate_step1 example
numeric_cols = [
    'movie_financial_summary_production_budget',
    'movie_financial_summary_international_box_office',
    'movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold',
    'movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units',
    'movie_running_time',
    'movie_sequel',
    'movie_production_year'
]
for col in numeric_cols:
    if col in df_union.columns:
        # For production year and sequel, fillna with 0 only if needed (usually production year should not be NaN)
        if df_union[col].dtype.kind in 'biufc':
            df_union[col] = df_union[col].fillna(0)

# For string columns, fill NaN with empty string to avoid issues
string_cols = [
    'movie_display_name',
    'movie_genre_display_name',
    'movie_acting_role_display_name',
    'movie_theatrical_release_release_date',
    'movie_creative_type_display_name',
    'movie_production_method_display_name',
    'movie_source_display_name',
    'movie_technical_role_display_name',
    'movie_production_company_display_name',
]
for col in string_cols:
    if col in df_union.columns:
        df_union[col] = df_union[col].fillna("")

# Ensure correct dtypes as per target schema:
# movie_display_name: string
df_union['movie_display_name'] = df_union['movie_display_name'].astype(str)
# movie_production_year: integer
df_union['movie_production_year'] = df_union['movie_production_year'].astype(int)
# movie_genre_display_name: string
df_union['movie_genre_display_name'] = df_union['movie_genre_display_name'].astype(str)
# movie_financial_summary_production_budget: integer
df_union['movie_financial_summary_production_budget'] = df_union['movie_financial_summary_production_budget'].astype(int)
# movie_financial_summary_international_box_office: integer
df_union['movie_financial_summary_international_box_office'] = df_union['movie_financial_summary_international_box_office'].astype(int)
# movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold: float
df_union['movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold'] = df_union['movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold'].astype(float)
# movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units: float
df_union['movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units'] = df_union['movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units'].astype(float)
# movie_acting_role_display_name: string
df_union['movie_acting_role_display_name'] = df_union['movie_acting_role_display_name'].astype(str)
# movie_theatrical_release_release_date: string (keep as is)
df_union['movie_theatrical_release_release_date'] = df_union['movie_theatrical_release_release_date'].astype(str)
# movie_creative_type_display_name: string
df_union['movie_creative_type_display_name'] = df_union['movie_creative_type_display_name'].astype(str)
# movie_production_method_display_name: string
df_union['movie_production_method_display_name'] = df_union['movie_production_method_display_name'].astype(str)
# movie_source_display_name: string
df_union['movie_source_display_name'] = df_union['movie_source_display_name'].astype(str)
# movie_running_time: float
df_union['movie_running_time'] = df_union['movie_running_time'].astype(float)
# movie_technical_role_display_name: string
df_union['movie_technical_role_display_name'] = df_union['movie_technical_role_display_name'].astype(str)
# movie_production_company_display_name: string
df_union['movie_production_company_display_name'] = df_union['movie_production_company_display_name'].astype(str)
# movie_sequel: integer
df_union['movie_sequel'] = df_union['movie_sequel'].astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'movie_display_name',
    'movie_production_year',
    'movie_genre_display_name',
    'movie_financial_summary_production_budget',
    'movie_financial_summary_international_box_office',
    'movie_annual_summary_tickets_sold',
    'movie_video_summary_domestic_dvd_units',
    'movie_acting_role_display_name',
    'movie_theatrical_release_release_date',
    'movie_creative_type_display_name',
    'movie_production_method_display_name',
    'movie_source_display_name',
    'movie_running_time',
    'movie_technical_role_display_name',
    'movie_production_company_display_name',
    'movie_sequel'
]

df_final = df_union[target_columns]

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV file without the index
df_final.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_74/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
